title: Moment matching
label: Moment matching
checked: LOO with moment matching, with and without the split step: pointwise values, Pareto k, effective sample sizes, and estimates. Analytic posteriors with identical draws, and a same-seed fit.
description: For the analytic posteriors, loo's loo_moment_match.default() receives the same draws and exact log densities. For the fit, CmdStanR's loo(moment_match = TRUE) runs on a same-seed fit of the same program.
reference: loo 2.10.1.9000 loo_moment_match.default(), and cmdstanr 0.99.0 (commit 0a54123) loo(moment_match = TRUE)

inputs.name: Analytic regressions
inputs.detail: Conjugate normal regressions whose outlier needs shifts only, shifts and scaling, or a covariance map, with exact log densities (tests/MomentMatchFixture.php).

inputs.name: Regression fit
inputs.detail: A Stan regression with an outlier, 4 chains of 500 warmup and 1,000 sampling iterations, seed 20261012.

cases.name: Analytic regressions, unsplit
cases.reason: The phit posterior-draw kernels are required: Phit\draws_moments, Phit\draws_covariance_map, Phit\draws_affine; passed in CI (Linux) at commit 7391993, which records no per-quantity results.

cases.name: Analytic regressions, split
cases.reason: The phit posterior-draw kernels are required: Phit\draws_moments, Phit\draws_covariance_map, Phit\draws_affine; passed in CI (Linux) at commit 7391993, which records no per-quantity results.

cases.name: Analytic regressions, loo's own split
cases.reason: The phit posterior-draw kernels are required: Phit\draws_moments, Phit\draws_covariance_map, Phit\draws_affine; passed in CI (Linux) at commit 7391993, which records no per-quantity results.

cases.name: Regression fit
cases.reason: The phit posterior-draw kernels are required: Phit\draws_moments, Phit\draws_covariance_map, Phit\draws_affine; passed in CI (Linux) at commit 7391993, which records no per-quantity results.

known_differences: The split step uses the exact inverse of the accumulated affine map. loo 2.10.1 and earlier use an inverse that is wrong once a shift is combined with scaling or a covariance map, so with the split only shift-only observations are compared with those versions.
The split relative efficiency is the minimum over both halves of the draws; loo uses the second half twice.
Relative efficiencies are computed from exp(log_lik − max). Where loo reports NA because every likelihood value is tiny, CmdStanPHP must report a finite value.
